sections.section_name: Section A - Choose the Correct Answer

questions.question_text: When performing Pranayama in Yoga, what is the primary physical focus of the practitioner?
Which traditional team game requires players to sit in a central lane facing alternate directions?
What does the term 'Asana' mean in the practice of Yoga?
options: B) A physical posture or pose
questions.answer: B) A physical posture or pose

questions.question_text: In Kabaddi, what is the player called who crosses the midline into the opponent's territory to score points?
Which yoga pose, known as the Corpse Pose, is used at the end of a session for complete physical and mental relaxation?
What is a major physical benefit of playing the traditional hopping game of Langdi?
options: B) It builds leg strength and single-leg balance
C) It exercises the arms for throwing
questions.answer: B) It builds leg strength and single-leg balance

questions.question_text: During yoga stretching, what is the general breathing rule when you bend forward to touch your toes?
Which core-strengthening yoga posture resembles a snake raising its hood?
What key value is naturally developed by participating in community sports and traditional team games?
In Kabaddi, what must the raider constantly do without taking a breath while in the opponent's half?
Why is it important to synchronize your breathing with your physical movements during Yoga Sadhana? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Synchronizing breath with movement helps improve concentration, ensures steady oxygen flow to the muscles, and allows the body to stretch deeper safely without tension.

questions.question_text: Name two distinct physical benefits of playing the traditional game of Kho-Kho regularly. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Playing Kho-Kho regularly builds excellent cardiovascular stamina, increases sprinting speed, and significantly improves a player's overall agility and quick reflex actions.

questions.question_text: Describe the physical and mental benefits of performing Surya Namaskar (Sun Salutation) every morning. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Surya Namaskar provides a full-body workout that improves flexibility, strengthens core muscles, regulates breathing, and energizes both the body and mind for the day.

questions.question_text: In Kabaddi, what is the 'cant' and why is it essential for the raider to maintain it? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: The cant is the continuous, holding-breath chant of 'Kabaddi'. It is essential because stopping the chant means the raider loses their turn and is declared out.

questions.question_text: How does maintaining a perfectly straight spine during seated yoga postures benefit your body? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: A straight spine ensures proper alignment, reduces back strain, improves core stability, and allows the lungs to expand fully for deeper, healthier breathing.

questions.question_text: Imagine you are guiding a beginner through the Lotus Pose (Padmasana). Describe the correct leg placement and sitting posture they must achieve. [40-50 words]
questions.answer: Sit on the floor with your spine perfectly straight. Carefully bend your right knee and place your right foot onto your left thigh. Then, bring your left foot onto your right thigh. Rest your hands gently on your knees and breathe calmly.

questions.question_text: Imagine you are a defender in a fast-paced game of Kabaddi. Describe the tactical formation you and your teammates would use to trap the raider. [40-50 words]
questions.answer: We would hold hands tightly to form a strong, semi-circular defensive chain. As the raider steps deep into our half, the corner players would swiftly move behind him to close the gap, trapping the raider with a coordinated group tackle.

questions.question_text: Explain how playing local team games like Kho-Kho helps develop both strong community bonding and individual strategic thinking. [50-60 words]
questions.answer: Local games require players to communicate effectively and trust each other, naturally building strong community bonds and friendships. Individually, players must constantly analyze the game, anticipate opponents' moves, and decide in a split second when to dodge or pass the turn, which sharply improves their strategic thinking and mental alertness.

questions.question_text: Describe how combining specific Yoga Asanas with Pranayama (breathing control) over a few months can transform a student's physical stamina and mental focus. [50-60 words]
questions.answer: Practicing Asanas builds core muscular strength and flexibility, while Pranayama maximizes lung capacity and oxygen intake. Over months, this powerful combination significantly boosts physical stamina, reducing fatigue during activities. Mentally, the deep, controlled breathing calms the nervous system, drastically improving the student's concentration and ability to focus.
